title: Pocketwire Rewards Anniversary Bonus Amount
content:
The Pocketwire Rewards anniversary bonus credited for an anniversary is the anniversary tier amount, which is the anniversary bonus points of the tier held on the credit date, in whole points.

## Calculation

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| Tier held on the credit date | the membership record on the day the bonus is credited |
| Anniversary bonus points of that tier | the product's tier figure, the anniversary bonus points |

The points credited are the anniversary tier amount: the anniversary bonus points of the tier held on the credit date, as a whole number of points.

## Worked examples (hypothetical memberships)

- A membership holds a tier whose anniversary bonus points are 1000 on the credit date. The anniversary bonus credited is 1000 points.
- A membership held one tier on its anniversary and moved to a higher tier at a quarterly review before the bonus was credited. The tier held on the credit date is the higher tier, so the anniversary tier amount is that higher tier's anniversary bonus points.
- A membership holds a tier whose anniversary bonus points are 0 on the credit date. The anniversary bonus credited is 0 points.

## Basis questions

- Which date decides the tier? The credit date, the day the bonus is booked.
- Are the points ever fractional? No; the anniversary tier amount is a whole number of points.
